# Copilot packaging note

This repository now carries parallel plugin manifests for Codex, Claude, and
Cursor at the repository root.

GitHub Copilot marketplace packaging is intentionally not finalized yet.

Why:

- the current product priority is to optimize IssueAI as a usable bug-hunting
  tool first;
- the cross-host benchmark is still growing in historical batches;
- Copilot packaging should follow the same stable marketplace/distribution shape
  once the host-facing plugin bundle is less in flux.

Use this folder later when the Copilot-specific marketplace entry and packaging
rules are ready to be frozen.
